notes.title: I AM DOG v1.06 --- New Hat Closet! New Hats!
notes.notes:
I AM DOG v1.06

GENERAL UPDATES

Remodeled New Hat Closet!
Increased the size of the Hat Closet to allow for additional hats, and also easier traversal to reach top shelves.

New Hats!
-Sneak Hat Added
-Clubbing Hat Added
-Future Hat Added

New Side room!

Additional messaging added in the ENDING to let players know there's a 99 Mode :)


BUG FIXES
 
- Chomping dirt at the start extremely fast would crash the game. :S Should no longer crash no matter HOW FAST YOU CHOMP. GO ON. CHOMP AWAY.

BALANCING

-Free Shop Items ability hat nerfed. Item shop will now only give 1 Health Item and 2 Randomized Items.

FUTURE UPDATES

I'd like to add a Time Attack Mode for the story, it's just in the concept phase so not anytime soon, sorry!
I do plan on adding additional hats and new side rooms and maybe more biomes for 99 mode in the future.

Thank you so much for playing!

-chris
